scope: Local macOS arm64 offline Gateway invocation resilience and safe staged runtime diagnostics; unpublished and untagged.

platform.compiler:
Apple Swift version 6.4 (swiftlang-6.4.0.34.1 clang-2100.3.34.1)
Target: arm64-apple-macosx27.0.0
platform.execution: Synthetic peers and local loopback. Approved host access used where compiler plugins, temporary files or local socket tests required it; no credentials or live Discord requests.

implemented: Explicit failFast default and continueInvocations policy
Fixed stages and closed safe categories with optional numeric API/fatal-close evidence
No response fallback, token refresh, handler replay or mutation retry
Terminal trusted-input, continuity/overflow, cancellation and shared owner failures
Bounded primary plus two additional diagnostic entries and joined cleanup
Safe terminal owner evidence captured before HTTP normalization and suppressed cleanup failures

checks.name: focused recovery diagnostics and operation ownership
coverage: Exactly-once uncertain submissions without response fallback or replay
Cancellation, repeated shutdown and zero final ownership
Secret sentinels, closed typed mappings, numeric API evidence and finite aggregate classification
Original public typed catches, middleware error replacement and nested routing

checks.name: independent consumers and extension adoption
notes: Final source includes secondary cleanup-owner capture. DSLBot explicitly selects continueInvocations. No command registration or authenticated calls.

checks.name: reviewed definitions and callable documentation
commands: swift run --package-path Tools/DiscordKitTools DiscordKitTools documentation audit --repository .
swift run --package-path Tools/DiscordKitTools DiscordKitTools inventory validate --repository .
swift run --package-path Tools/DiscordKitTools DiscordKitTools parity check --repository .
notes: Generated outputs require no regeneration. Documentation presence is syntactic evidence; source and independent review remain separate.

checks.name: public API and DocC
notes: The 0.16.0 comparison has 129 added symbols and two replaced initializer declarations with defaulted new parameters; 0.17.0 satisfies the pre-1.0 breaking-change policy. Ordinary initializer calls compile unchanged; explicit initializer function references need review. No ABI or unavailable-platform API qualification.

checks.name: selected Apple minimum-target module compilation
notes: Selected logging/foundation/media/Apple modules, including changed Transport scope plumbing. Module emission only; no complete-package cross-build, linking, device execution, minimum-OS runtime or hardware qualification.

checks.name: finite local HTTP Gateway and cache scenarios
commands: swift run --package-path Tools/DiscordKitLoadTests DiscordKitLoadTests --scenario http --profile accounts-100
swift run --package-path Tools/DiscordKitLoadTests DiscordKitLoadTests --scenario gateway --profile accounts-100
swift run --package-path Tools/DiscordKitLoadTests DiscordKitLoadTests --scenario cache --profile accounts-100
notes: Final-source Debug executable; synthetic local work; concurrent validation excludes controlled performance comparison.

checks.name: historical release and maintenance records
notes: Historical hash-bound evidence is preserved and does not certify new source.

checks.name: fixed-working-set cache and broadcast soak
commands: swift run -c release --package-path Tools/DiscordKitLoadTests --disable-sandbox --cache-path .build/recovery-swiftpm-cache --config-path .build/recovery-swiftpm-config --security-path .build/recovery-swiftpm-security DiscordKitLoadTests --scenario soak --profile accounts-1000000 --burst --duration-seconds 1800
notes: Four actual scopes and fixed 20 keys per scope; logical accounts are an arithmetic profile dimension, not a million users or tasks.

Cache/broadcast workload owners are unchanged since measured binary build. HTTP cleanup instrumentation was refined during the run and is outside its zero-HTTP workload. The environment artifact records the source capture timing and exact binary identity.
No invocation/Client projection/real shard/device/network/production capacity claim; no controlled timing or performance regression comparison.

checks.name: final source and document review
notes: Independent runtime, security, privacy and ownership review found no remaining blockers. Changed JSON parses, relative Markdown file links resolve, and parity history is append-only. No commit or publication performed.

executionAttempts.result: Aborted signal 5 in a NIO HTTP fixture during parallel suite startup; no completed result total. Default-driver final full suite passed separately.
Shared build database was locked while the public symbol dump was compiling. Sequential default-driver final build and tests passed.

executionAttempts.attempt: Managed default compiler or loopback execution
executionAttempts.result: Sandbox denied compiler/plugin temporary work or local sockets. Isolated writable caches and approved host access completed the affected checks.

qualificationLimits: No live Discord acceptance or cause attribution for MiniCarson's pre-existing Failed state
No independent security or crypto review, complete-client interoperability, or device/hardware qualification
No Linux, Windows, Android, full Apple package/runtime or production/fleet capacity qualification

Safe response fingerprints describe observed categories and cannot prove causal identity after same-category application replacement; unknown/differently replaced errors fall back to the escaping handler boundary
No automatic failure response, reconciliation or retry safety is established by API status/code or mutation uncertainty
Synchronous observers must return promptly and be concurrency-safe; noncooperative application work cannot be forcibly joined
The native combined test runner is excluded after its NIO fixture abort; passing root evidence uses the default driver
